item_short_desc: Rothco’s Military Type Camo Net is crafted for optimal concealment in outdoor settings. Made from durable rip-stop fabric reinforced with mesh for added strength, this hunting net ensures reliable performance in varied conditions. Its reversible foliage pattern allows you to adapt to different environments with a choice between a brown or green exterior. The net is 100% waterproof and resistant to rot and mold, making it suitable for long-term outdoor use.
description: Rothco’s Military Type Camo Net is crafted for optimal concealment in outdoor settings. Made from durable rip-stop fabric reinforced with mesh for added strength, this hunting net ensures reliable performance in varied conditions. Its reversible foliage pattern allows you to adapt to different environments with a choice between a brown or green exterior. The net is 100% waterproof and resistant to rot and mold, making it suitable for long-term outdoor use. Treated to eliminate glare and shine, it provides excellent cover without attracting unwanted attention. UV treatment protects the net from sun damage, ensuring extended lifespan and reliability. Available in two sizes, this lightweight and compactable camo net is an essential tool for hunters, photographers, and outdoor enthusiasts seeking effective concealment.
